main_measure.name: OLS slope of coin-demeaned 3-bar forward return on forecast (non-overlapping grid, pooled)
main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope > 0 with t >= 2; reject: slope < 0 with t <= -2; otherwise inconclusive; at least 300 non-overlapping cases

decided_by: The slope is positive with t = 5.20 >= 2 over 5920 cases (confirm rule).
reading: The coin's mean 3-bar return is taken over that coin's non-overlapping grid samples pooled over all its windows, the regression is OLS with an intercept, the 300-case minimum counts the pooled grid cases with a forecast and a return, and the situation check rebuilds standardise from raw values where the full 60-bar history is inside the window and uses the recorded post-pipeline values before that.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.002076 on the check half (2022 onward) against +0.002432 on every window
